title: Roadmap: read, trace and governed change requests
description: Use when reading, tracing an LPM roadmap (rastreabilidade), creating a roadmap, one item or a capability (even on owner order), or change requests (pedido de mudança): submit, review, decide, apply. Not for direct owner commits (use lpm-roadmap-owner-ops) or change sets (use lpm-requirements-scope).
doneWhen: The roadmap read is reported, or the request is in the asked state and a re-read confirms it.
authorityCeiling: Submit/revise/withdraw [C]; review, apply and structure writes [O] (GOV-MAX v1); the rest [A].
jobs: show the LPM roadmap overview of this workspace
qual a rastreabilidade do item <título>? onde ele está sendo executado?
propose raising the priority of roadmap item <title> (change request)
o que tenho para revisar no roadmap? aprove o pedido de mudança <id>
apply the approved roadmap change request <id>
retire o pedido de mudança <id> e envie um novo
which work in project <name> is not linked to the roadmap?
create a capability "Payments" in the roadmap (owner order)

notFor.when: owner-ordered direct item edit, archive/restore, bulk, import, roadmap dependency/allocation, lifecycle gate, materialization, governance mode
code evidence or impact of an item
a decision thread on an item or request

references.loadWhen: playbook trace: trace an item, or a project's roadmap work
playbook propose-link: change request: allocate or link one item
playbook propose-change: change request: edit, prioritize, lifecycle, archive or restore one item
playbook comment: comment on a change request
playbook revise-or-withdraw: revise or withdraw a change request
playbook review: record the owner's review decision
playbook apply: apply an approved change request
playbook capability: create, edit or archive a capability
playbook create-item: create a roadmap item (never a change request)
playbook roadmap-header: create or edit a roadmap header

codex.shortDescription: Read the LPM roadmap and run governed change requests
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-roadmap to show the LPM roadmap of workspace <workspaceId> or propose a governed change to an item.
